items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: So while I was in London in 1933, so Lord Beaverbrook... he throws this party at his mansion... We play this party

ctx.x: Millions of people are my friends. I know. That's all I can say. I was there, baby. When you can say you was there, that's high-low jack and the game. You better believe it.

But let me tell you a little incident. This will kill you. So while I was in London in 1933, so Lord Beaverbrook, he's a Canadian, but he owns all the newspapers. You may have heard of him. He's big, big there. He would throw him a party so he throws this party at his mansion, you know, and
he had the guy that's married to the Queen now. He was just another turkey then, he wasn't married to her then. He hit the jackpot there.
